propositions: Compiled state tracks plan_review_phase (planning|execution) updated only by winning STATUS transitions: in_progress→execution, open→planning, others preserve; losing forks and force transitions follow the same rule.

Snapshots persist plan_review_phase through compaction; pre-feature snapshots bootstrap phase once from compiled status (open/idea→planning, others→execution) with lazy cache-versioned recomputation and INFO logging.

Manifests emit review-phase (planning|execution) and execution-only priority-floor: 0.80 in fixed order after advisory, validated by manifest.validate_review_phase_metadata and sidecar.parse_review_phase_metadata with strict syntax/schema enforcement.

Phase compatibility matrix: planning state accepts planning/legacy/execution attestations; execution state accepts planning/legacy and execution floor≥0.80, rejects execution floor<0.80, with all malformed combinations producing phase_status=malformed.

Signing captures immutable PlanReviewGeneration before LLM; three retries on HEAD instability only; any stable generation change is terminal stale; under-lock HEAD/generation re-verification required before atomic append; LLM/provider failure writes no state.
Pass-3 execution_review parameter floors blocking threshold to 0.80 only when blocking_enabled=True and execution_review=True; planning and advisory-only paths unchanged.
